name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The company completed an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate in 2026 and has been actively drilling to expand high-grade silver-gold mineralization. It also holds an earn-in option on the La Coipita project in San Juan, Argentina, in joint venture with Teck.
